sources.description: Text-layer extraction of the Satucket Software PDF reproduction of the 1662 Book of Common Prayer as printed by John Baskerville, Cambridge, 1762 (Griffiths 1762/4; Gaskell 19).
sources.witness: Book of Common Prayer, Cambridge: John Baskerville, 1762
sources.format: UTF-8 text, CRLF line endings, LF-only lines at page boundaries
sources.obtained: 2026-10-13, uploaded to the Lux project by Jackson
sources.termsVerbatim: You may redistribute this document electronically provided no fee is charged and this header remains part of the document.
sources.notes: The PDF itself has not been supplied; only this extraction. Page numbers derived from it are extraction pages, unverified against PDF page indices.

sources.description: TEI XML keyboarding by the Text Creation Partnership (EEBO-TCP A28758) of the 1662 Book of Common Prayer as printed in London by Charles Bill and the executrix of Thomas Newcomb, 1693 (Wing B3687; ESTC R30847). Used only for the tables the Baskerville text layer lacks: the Kalendar with the Table of Lessons, the Proper Lessons and the Proper Psalms.
sources.reproducer: Text Creation Partnership (Ann Arbor, MI; Oxford), from Early English Books Online page images
sources.witness: Book of Common Prayer, London: Charles Bill and the executrix of Thomas Newcomb, 1693
sources.format: TEI P5 XML; tables keyed one cell per row
sources.obtained: 2026-10-20, downloaded by Claude at Jackson's direction (decision in the project's lesson-table thread)

sources.notes: A different printing from the primary witness. Its tables have not been compared with the Baskerville pages, which are not available. Line numbers in Lux provenance for this source are XML lines; pages are the TCP image references (facs).
